name: loss_tabicl
caption: Mean synthetic query loss over each 100-update window, separated by backbone and peak learning rate; colors identify credit fractions, thin traces show individual training seeds and thick curves average two seeds at common recorded steps. A symmetric-log loss axis, explicitly labeled where used, retains extreme finite losses; its central interval [-1,1] is linear.
